installation_contract.rust: After verified extraction, run each official component install.sh with --prefix=<tools>/rustc/prefix --disable-ldconfig; install rustc, cargo, rust-std into that same prefix. Record installed rustc/cargo/std identities against archive members. Do not use network rustup.
installation_contract.paired_libclang: Create verified links/copies of chromium-rust/lib/libclang* in clang/lib, keeping all symlink targets inside owned tools root, so LIBCLANG_PATH parent/bin/clang finds matching clang23/resource headers. Rehash final dereferenced libclang.
installation_contract.rusty_v8_rust_sentinel: In prepared chromium-rust write .rusty_v8_version containing the exact pinned chromium-rust URL; this is acquisition marker only, never replace archive/executable hash verification.
installation_contract.executable_modes: Restore archive executable modes and test native --version on the matching build host.
installation_contract.redirect_validation: At most 5 HTTPS redirects; each URL hostname must match tool.redirect_hosts; verify final archive SHA before extraction.
